SPH cubic spline smoothing kernel (3D). Provides static radius setup and evaluation of kernel value, gradient, and W at zero. Uses Real/Vector3r.

functions.name: SPH::CubicKernel::getRadius
functions.description: Returns the current support radius h used by the cubic spline SPH kernel. Use this to query the radius previously set via setRadius.
requirements: No special preconditions.
Meaningful value only after SPH::CubicKernel::setRadius(...) has been called.

functions.name: SPH::CubicKernel::setRadius
functions.description: Sets the support radius h for the cubic spline kernel and precomputes kernel constants and W(0). Must be called before evaluating W/gradW.
requirements: val must be positive (h > 0) to avoid divisions by zero in internal computations.
Must be called before any call to SPH::CubicKernel::W(...), SPH::CubicKernel::gradW(...), or SPH::CubicKernel::W_zero().

functions.name: SPH::CubicKernel::W
functions.description: Evaluates the cubic spline kernel value W at scalar distance r from the particle center. Returns 0 for r > h.
requirements: SPH::CubicKernel::setRadius(h) must be called beforehand.
Input r should be non-negative; function assumes r is a distance.
For r > h the return value is 0 by design.

functions.name: SPH::CubicKernel::gradW
functions.description: Evaluates the gradient of the cubic spline kernel ∇W at offset r. Returns zero vector for |r| > h or near-zero |r| to avoid singularities.
requirements: SPH::CubicKernel::setRadius(h) must be called beforehand.
Input r can be zero or any vector; implementation guards against |r| ≈ 0 with an epsilon and returns zero in that case.
For |r| > h the returned gradient is zero.

functions.name: SPH::CubicKernel::W_zero
functions.description: Returns the precomputed value W(0) for the cubic spline kernel with the current radius.
requirements: SPH::CubicKernel::setRadius(h) must be called beforehand.

functions.name: SPH::Poly6Kernel::getRadius
functions.description: Returns the current support radius h used by the Poly6 SPH kernel.
requirements: Meaningful value only after SPH::Poly6Kernel::setRadius(...) has been called.

functions.name: SPH::Poly6Kernel::setRadius
functions.description: Sets the support radius h for the Poly6 kernel and precomputes constants and W(0). Must be called before evaluating W/gradW/laplacianW.
requirements: val must be positive (h > 0).
Must be called before SPH::Poly6Kernel::W(...), gradW(...), laplacianW(...), or W_zero().

functions.name: SPH::Poly6Kernel::W
functions.description: Evaluates the Poly6 kernel value W at scalar distance r. Returns 0 for r > h.
requirements: SPH::Poly6Kernel::setRadius(h) must be called beforehand.
Input r should be non-negative distance.
Returns 0 if r > h.

functions.name: SPH::Poly6Kernel::gradW
functions.description: Evaluates the gradient ∇W of the Poly6 kernel at offset r. Zero outside the support.
requirements: SPH::Poly6Kernel::setRadius(h) must be called beforehand.
r may be any vector; for |r| > h gradient is zero.

functions.name: SPH::Poly6Kernel::laplacianW
functions.description: Evaluates the Laplacian ∇²W of the Poly6 kernel at offset r. Zero outside the support.
requirements: SPH::Poly6Kernel::setRadius(h) must be called beforehand.

functions.name: SPH::Poly6Kernel::W_zero
functions.description: Returns the precomputed value W(0) for the Poly6 kernel with the current radius.
requirements: SPH::Poly6Kernel::setRadius(h) must be called beforehand.

functions.name: SPH::SpikyKernel::getRadius
functions.description: Returns the current support radius h used by the spiky SPH kernel.
requirements: Meaningful value only after SPH::SpikyKernel::setRadius(...) has been called.

functions.name: SPH::SpikyKernel::setRadius
functions.description: Sets the support radius h for the spiky kernel and precomputes constants and W(0). Must be called before evaluating W/gradW.
requirements: val must be positive (h > 0).
Must be called before SPH::SpikyKernel::W(...), gradW(...), or W_zero().

functions.name: SPH::SpikyKernel::W
functions.description: Evaluates the spiky kernel value W at scalar distance r. Returns 0 for r > h.
requirements: SPH::SpikyKernel::setRadius(h) must be called beforehand.
Input r should be non-negative distance.
Returns 0 if r > h.

functions.name: SPH::SpikyKernel::gradW
functions.description: Evaluates the gradient ∇W of the spiky kernel at offset r. Zero outside the support. Note: implementation divides by |r| without an explicit epsilon guard.
requirements: SPH::SpikyKernel::setRadius(h) must be called beforehand.
Do not call with r == 0 vector (|r| = 0) to avoid division by zero/NaN.
For |r| > h the returned gradient is zero.

functions.name: SPH::SpikyKernel::W_zero
functions.description: Returns the precomputed value W(0) for the spiky kernel with the current radius.
requirements: SPH::SpikyKernel::setRadius(h) must be called beforehand.

functions.name: SPH::WendlandQuinticC2Kernel::getRadius
functions.description: Returns the current support radius h used by the Wendland Quintic C2 SPH kernel.
requirements: Meaningful value only after SPH::WendlandQuinticC2Kernel::setRadius(...) has been called.

functions.name: SPH::WendlandQuinticC2Kernel::setRadius
functions.description: Sets the support radius h for the Wendland Quintic C2 kernel and precomputes constants and W(0). Must be called before evaluating W/gradW.
requirements: val must be positive (h > 0).
Must be called before SPH::WendlandQuinticC2Kernel::W(...), gradW(...), or W_zero().

functions.name: SPH::WendlandQuinticC2Kernel::W
functions.description: Evaluates the Wendland Quintic C2 kernel W at scalar distance r. Returns 0 for r > h.
requirements: SPH::WendlandQuinticC2Kernel::setRadius(h) must be called beforehand.
Input r should be non-negative distance.

functions.name: SPH::WendlandQuinticC2Kernel::gradW
functions.description: Evaluates the gradient ∇W of the Wendland Quintic C2 kernel at offset r. Zero outside the support; internally scales r/|r| with guard via multiplication by 1/(|r|*h).
requirements: SPH::WendlandQuinticC2Kernel::setRadius(h) must be called beforehand.
If r is the zero vector, result is zero due to guard; otherwise any vector is accepted.
For |r| > h the returned gradient is zero.

functions.name: SPH::WendlandQuinticC2Kernel::W_zero
functions.description: Returns the precomputed value W(0) for the Wendland Quintic C2 kernel with the current radius.
requirements: SPH::WendlandQuinticC2Kernel::setRadius(h) must be called beforehand.

functions.name: SPH::CohesionKernel::getRadius
functions.description: Returns the current support radius h used by the cohesion kernel (Akinci et al.).
requirements: Meaningful value only after SPH::CohesionKernel::setRadius(...) has been called.

functions.name: SPH::CohesionKernel::setRadius
functions.description: Sets the support radius h for the cohesion kernel and precomputes constants and W(0). Must be called before W.
requirements: val must be positive (h > 0).
Must be called before SPH::CohesionKernel::W(...) or W_zero().

functions.name: SPH::CohesionKernel::W
functions.description: Evaluates the cohesion kernel W at scalar distance r per Akinci et al. Returns 0 outside the support and applies piecewise formula within.
requirements: SPH::CohesionKernel::setRadius(h) must be called beforehand.
Input r should be non-negative distance.

functions.name: SPH::CohesionKernel::W_zero
functions.description: Returns the precomputed value W(0) for the cohesion kernel with the current radius.
requirements: SPH::CohesionKernel::setRadius(h) must be called beforehand.

functions.name: SPH::AdhesionKernel::getRadius
functions.description: Returns the current support radius h used by the adhesion kernel (Akinci et al.).
requirements: Meaningful value only after SPH::AdhesionKernel::setRadius(...) has been called.

functions.name: SPH::AdhesionKernel::setRadius
functions.description: Sets the support radius h for the adhesion kernel and precomputes constants and W(0). Must be called before W.
requirements: val must be positive (h > 0).
Must be called before SPH::AdhesionKernel::W(...) or W_zero().

functions.name: SPH::AdhesionKernel::W
functions.description: Evaluates the adhesion kernel W at scalar distance r (nonzero only for h/2 < r <= h). Returns 0 otherwise.
requirements: SPH::AdhesionKernel::setRadius(h) must be called beforehand.
Input r should be non-negative distance.
For r ≤ h/2 or r > h, result is 0 by definition.

functions.name: SPH::AdhesionKernel::W_zero
functions.description: Returns the precomputed value W(0) for the adhesion kernel with the current radius.
requirements: SPH::AdhesionKernel::setRadius(h) must be called beforehand.

functions.name: SPH::CubicKernel2D::setRadius
functions.description: Sets the support radius h for the 2D cubic spline kernel and precomputes constants and W(0). Must be called before W/gradW.
requirements: val must be positive (h > 0).
Must be called before SPH::CubicKernel2D::W(...), gradW(...), or W_zero().

functions.name: SPH::CubicKernel2D::W
functions.description: Evaluates the 2D cubic spline kernel W at scalar distance r. Returns 0 for r > h.
requirements: SPH::CubicKernel2D::setRadius(h) must be called beforehand.
Input r should be non-negative distance.

functions.name: SPH::CubicKernel2D::gradW
functions.description: Evaluates the gradient ∇W of the 2D cubic spline kernel at offset r. Zero outside the support. Note: computation uses r/|r| and only assigns a value when |r| > eps.
requirements: SPH::CubicKernel2D::setRadius(h) must be called beforehand.
Avoid calling with r very close to zero; for |r| ≤ 1e-9, the implementation avoids division but, when q ≤ 1, res may remain uninitialized; treat such cases as returning zero gradient.
For |r| > h the returned gradient is zero.

functions.name: SPH::CubicKernel2D::W_zero
functions.description: Returns the precomputed value W(0) for the 2D cubic spline kernel with the current radius.
requirements: SPH::CubicKernel2D::setRadius(h) must be called beforehand.

functions.name: SPH::PrecomputedKernel::getRadius
functions.signature: template <typename KernelType, unsigned int resolution> static Real SPH::PrecomputedKernel<KernelType, resolution>::getRadius()
functions.description: Returns the current support radius h used by the precomputed lookup-table wrapper around a kernel type.
requirements: Meaningful value only after SPH::PrecomputedKernel<...>::setRadius(...) has been called.
Template requirements: none for this method beyond valid instantiation.

functions.name: SPH::PrecomputedKernel::setRadius
functions.signature: template <typename KernelType, unsigned int resolution> static void SPH::PrecomputedKernel<KernelType, resolution>::setRadius(Real val)
functions.description: Sets the support radius h and builds lookup tables for W(r) and grad W(r)/r for the provided KernelType at the specified resolution. Calls KernelType::setRadius(val) internally.
requirements: val must be positive (h > 0).
Must be called before SPH::PrecomputedKernel<...>::W(...), gradW(...), or W_zero().
Template requirements on KernelType: must provide static void setRadius(Real), static Real W(Real), static Real W(const Vector3r&), static Vector3r gradW(const Vector3r&).

functions.name: SPH::PrecomputedKernel::W
functions.signature: template <typename KernelType, unsigned int resolution> static Real SPH::PrecomputedKernel<KernelType, resolution>::W(const Vector3r &r)
functions.description: Evaluates W at offset r using the precomputed lookup table for the chosen KernelType. Returns 0 for |r| > h.
requirements: SPH::PrecomputedKernel<...>::setRadius(h) must be called beforehand.
r may be any vector; |r| > h yields 0.

functions.name: SPH::PrecomputedKernel::gradW
functions.signature: template <typename KernelType, unsigned int resolution> static Vector3r SPH::PrecomputedKernel<KernelType, resolution>::gradW(const Vector3r &r)
functions.description: Evaluates the gradient ∇W at offset r using the precomputed lookup table (stored as radial derivative divided by r, then scaled by r). Returns zero vector for |r| > h.
requirements: SPH::PrecomputedKernel<...>::setRadius(h) must be called beforehand.
r may be any vector; for |r| > h the gradient is zero.

functions.name: SPH::PrecomputedKernel::W_zero
functions.signature: template <typename KernelType, unsigned int resolution> static Real SPH::PrecomputedKernel<KernelType, resolution>::W_zero()
functions.description: Returns the precomputed value W(0) taken from the underlying KernelType after table build.
requirements: SPH::PrecomputedKernel<...>::setRadius(h) must be called beforehand.
